Refunds: orders can be refunded within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days after approval by the billing team.
Invoices: invoices are available in the customer portal under Billing > Invoices. A copy can also be requested from billing@example.com.
Password reset: customers can reset their password at https://app.example.com/reset. Reset links expire after 60 minutes.
Two-factor authentication: if a customer lost their 2FA device, an agent must verify identity before 2FA can be removed.
Shipping: standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the EU. Tracking links are sent by email when the order ships.
API rate limits: the public API allows 600 requests per minute per API key. Error code 429 means the limit was reached.
Plan upgrades: customers can upgrade from Settings > Plan at any time; the price difference is prorated.
